purpose: Compact league marks for Banner TV onboarding horizontal competition pills.

notes: Render the logo inside a fixed 20x20 frame so wide wordmarks never widen the pill.
Use aspectFit and never crop or circle-mask league marks.
Keep the abbreviation/text outside the logo frame.
Cache resolved remote logos; do not re-fetch when pills scroll on/off screen.
If a remote logo fails, fall back to the sport SF Symbol rather than showing a broken image.

espnLeagueMetadata.description: Read the league logo from the ESPN scoreboard metadata response and cache the resolved href by catalogLeagueId.

wikipediaPageImage.description: Fallback only. Resolve the page-image thumbnail source and cache it. Do not perform this request repeatedly while scrolling.
